# google_vertex_ai_project_publisher_model_config

Manages the project-wide default configuration for Vertex AI Model Garden
publisher models in a Google Cloud project.

Each project has a single project-wide publisher model configuration;
creating or updating this resource authoritatively replaces that
configuration, and destroying this resource clears all project-wide publisher
model configuration settings on the project.

~> **Warning:** This resource is in beta, and should be used with the terraform-provider-google-beta provider.
See [Provider Versions](../guides/provider_versions.html.markdown) for more details on beta resources.

To get more information about ProjectPublisherModelConfig, see:

* [API documentation](https://docs.cloud.google.com/gemini-enterprise-agent-platform/reference/rest/v1beta1/projects/setPublisherModelConfig)
* How-to Guides
    * [Inference metadata logging](https://docs.cloud.google.com/gemini-enterprise-agent-platform/models/capabilities/inference-metadata-logging)
    * [Use models in Model Garden](https://cloud.google.com/vertex-ai/generative-ai/docs/model-garden/use-models)


## Example Usage - Vertex Ai Project Publisher Model Config Basic


```hcl
resource "google_vertex_ai_project_publisher_model_config" "config" {
  provider = google-beta

  inference_event_logging_config {
    state = "ENABLED"
  }
}
```

## Example Usage - Vertex Ai Project Publisher Model Config Full


```hcl
resource "google_bigquery_dataset" "logs" {
  provider                   = google-beta
  dataset_id                 = "project_publisher_model_logs"
  location                   = "US"
  delete_contents_on_destroy = true
}

resource "google_vertex_ai_project_publisher_model_config" "config" {
  provider = google-beta

  inference_event_logging_config {
    state = "ENABLED"
  }

  logging_config {
    enabled       = true
    sampling_rate = 0.5

    bigquery_destination {
      output_uri = "bq://${google_bigquery_dataset.logs.project}.${google_bigquery_dataset.logs.dataset_id}.request_response_logs"
    }
  }
}
```

## Argument Reference

The following arguments are supported:



* `inference_event_logging_config` -
  (Optional)
  Configures project-wide default emission of the per-request
  `aiplatform.googleapis.com/inference_request` Cloud Logging log, which
  records structured per-request metadata (such as principal, traffic type,
  and token usage) for publisher-model traffic in the project. This is
  distinct from `logging_config`, which logs raw request and response
  payloads to a BigQuery table.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_inference_event_logging_config).

* `logging_config` -
  (Optional)
  Project-wide default configuration for logging prediction requests and
  responses to a BigQuery table.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_logging_config).

* `project` - (Optional) The ID of the project in which the resource belongs.
    If it is not provided, the provider project is used.

* `deletion_policy` - (Optional) Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the resource. Defaults to DELETE.
	When a 'terraform destroy' or 'terraform apply' would delete the resource,
	the command will fail if this field is set to "PREVENT" in Terraform state.
	When set to "ABANDON", the command will remove the resource from Terraform
	management without updating or deleting the resource in the API.
	When set to "DELETE", deleting the resource is allowed.


<a name="nested_inference_event_logging_config"></a>The `inference_event_logging_config` block supports:

* `state` -
  (Required)
  Whether emission of the `aiplatform.googleapis.com/inference_request`
  log is enabled across publisher models in the project.
  Possible values are: `ENABLED`, `DISABLED`.

<a name="nested_logging_config"></a>The `logging_config` block supports:

* `enabled` -
  (Optional)
  Whether project-wide default request-response logging is enabled.

* `sampling_rate` -
  (Optional)
  Percentage of requests to be logged, expressed as a fraction in the
  range `(0, 1]`.

* `bigquery_destination` -
  (Optional)
  BigQuery destination for request-response logging.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_logging_config_bigquery_destination).


<a name="nested_logging_config_bigquery_destination"></a>The `bigquery_destination` block supports:

* `output_uri` -
  (Required)
  BigQuery URI to a project, dataset, or table, up to 2000
  characters long, in the form `bq://projectId`,
  `bq://projectId.bqDatasetId`, or
  `bq://projectId.bqDatasetId.bqTableId`.

## Attributes Reference

In addition to the arguments listed above, the following computed attributes are exported:

* `id` - an identifier for the resource with format `projects/{{project}}`


## Timeouts

This resource provides the following
[Timeouts](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/plugin/sdkv2/resources/retries-and-customizable-timeouts) configuration options:

- `create` - Default is 20 minutes.
- `update` - Default is 20 minutes.
- `delete` - Default is 20 minutes.

## Import


ProjectPublisherModelConfig can be imported using any of these accepted formats:

* `projects/{{project}}`
* `{{project}}`

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, use an [`identity` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/block/import#identity) to import ProjectPublisherModelConfig using identity values. For example:

```tf
import {
  identity = {
    project = "<-optional value->"
  }
  to = google_vertex_ai_project_publisher_model_config.default
}
```

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, use an [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) to import ProjectPublisherModelConfig using one of the formats above. For example:

```tf
import {
  id = "projects/{{project}}"
  to = google_vertex_ai_project_publisher_model_config.default
}
```

When using the [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import), ProjectPublisherModelConfig can be imported using one of the formats above. For example:

```
$ terraform import google_vertex_ai_project_publisher_model_config.default projects/{{project}}
$ terraform import google_vertex_ai_project_publisher_model_config.default {{project}}
```
